diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all four rollouts resulted in identical decisions and commitments, despite no checks passing. The model consistently defaulted to a baseline schedule (e.g., navigation_window: 1300-1500) that ignores the specific constraints introduced by PF2 (weather restriction) and PF3 (bowser appointment), indicating the scenario's complexity is not being triggered.
fix_instructions: To force multi-agent dependency, increase the penalty for incorrect time windows or aircraft assignments. Specifically, tighten C3 and C7 (dependent on PF2) and C4 and C8 (dependent on PF3) so that any deviation from the specific times/locations dictated by those facts results in an immediate failure, preventing the model from defaulting to generic time blocks.
